messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired for service=redwood-inference-us-west-az3 (INC12345) — high error rate + node evictions. PD: https://pd.example/incidents/INC12345

pagerduty: Incident INC12345 — page sent to primary on-call (rotation).

alex.k: acked. jumping in. what's the observed customer impact?

maria.s: i'm up. seeing 502s from hosted API region us-west. latency spikes too. any correlation with autoscaler or recent deploy?

samir.r: infra telemetry shows KV cache eviction spike and GPU OOMs on several az3 nodes. node group az3-gpu-1 reporting CPU/IO pressure. dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/board/az3

alex.k: confirmed logs: multiple "shard_unavailable" and container OOMExit restarts across inference pods in az3.

maria.s: recommend routing fallback to other AZs while we stabilize. can someone kick off fallback policy?

alex.k: applying routing fallback now: `routectl apply --region=us-west --exclude=az3` — shifting traffic off az3.

ops-runbook-bot: Runbook triggered: Fallback to healthy AZs. Step 1: apply routing policy. Step 2: monitor 5xx and token latency for 10m.

alex.k: command output:
```
$ routectl apply --region=us-west --exclude=az3
ok: 12.3k rps shifted to az1/az2 (10m window)
```

jenn.l: starting a 10% canary to validate model performance and correctness in az1.

samir.r: quick infra note: node autoscaler in az3 failing scale-up calls: `scale-up failed: quota_exceeded` and some nodes stuck in provisioning. possible cloud capacity shortage.

maria.s: doing a rolling restart of inference deployment in az3 to reduce thread thrash: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/inference-us-west-az3 -n prod`

alex.k: sample logs from az3 pod:
```
[2024-06-21T03:12:08Z] ERROR model_shard.cpp: shard_unavailable shard=7
[2024-06-21T03:12:09Z] WARN kv_cache.cpp: eviction triggered, usage=98%
[2024-06-21T03:12:10Z] INFO containerd: oom_kill signal sent to pid 3245
```

pagerduty: INC12345 acknowledged by alex.k at 1718901240.

maria.s: customer impact estimate: roughly 3% of API requests received 5xx during the spike. top affected tenants: startup-io, analytics-hq. CS notified and support cases opened.

alex.k: DMed @support with incident summary and list of affected tenants + temporary mitigation instructions.

ops-runbook-bot: Threshold breached for escalation (persistent errors >2% for 15m). Escalating to infra lead @kevin.r.

kevin.r: joining. what's the autoscaler/instance state and cloud-side errors? any soft quota messages?

samir.r: autoscaler logs show repeated errors: `APIQuotaExceeded: insufficient capacity for request`. Cloud requested an increase; opened provider support ticket #CLOUD-9982.

kevin.r: coordinating with provider to request capacity. Keep fallback active until we have stable node provisioning. If errors remain >1% for next 15m, promote canary to full routing.

maria.s: promoting canary to 100% to be safe: `routectl promote-canary --id=c-az1-171890`

alex.k: promoted. total us-west error rate dropped from 3.1% to 0.6% after promotion. latency within SLOs on az1.

jenn.l: creating incident doc stub in /incidents/INC12345 and adding initial timeline + mitigation steps. tagging postmortem owners.

alex.k: preparing handoff notes for night on-call: fallback active, cloud ticket CLOUD-9982 open, autoscaler errors observed, rolling restarts in az3 in progress, CS updated.

oncall-rotation: acked. i'll monitor through 0200Z and escalate to SRE if error rate >1% sustained for 15m. leaving watch alerts as: `alert:az3_inference_error_rate > 1% for 15m`

incident-bot: INC12345 status -> mitigated (fallback active) — monitoring. Next auto-update in 30m or on any condition change.

alex.k: thanks team. leaving thread for handoff. will follow up on postmortem and quota outcome tomorrow. :thumbsup:
